items.title: Oriented interval meshes and broken polynomial spaces
items.statement: Define a finite increasing partition of a bounded interval and its cellwise polynomial space, traces, and jumps.
items.strategy: The published simplicial-mesh definition is explicitly for dimension at least two; supply the separate one-dimensional convention needed by the transport and SBP cases.

items.title: Diagonal-norm summation-by-parts element data
items.statement: Define positive diagonal volume norms, derivative matrices, face trace maps and positive face quadrature matrices satisfying the exact multidirectional SBP and constant-preservation identities, with paired interface nodes.
items.strategy: Make all matrix sizes, orientations, positivity requirements and exact identities part of the data; assert no existence for arbitrary meshes.

items.title: Upwind discontinuous Galerkin discretization of constant transport
items.statement: Define the elementwise weak upwind DG method for scalar constant-coefficient transport, with inflow data and matching interior numerical fluxes, in dimensions one and at least two.
items.strategy: State both mesh branches, every trace convention, the weak form, and the boundary and interior fluxes.

items.title: Forward-Euler step for degree-zero upwind DG transport
items.statement: Define the periodic degree-zero upwind DG update on a matching affine simplicial mesh, with its cellwise face-CFL admissibility condition.
items.strategy: Give the exact volume-weighted coefficient form of the one-step cell update; make periodic indexing explicit.

items.title: Cellwise L2 projection relation onto broken polynomials
items.statement: Define the cellwise orthogonality relation that specifies an L2 projection onto the stated broken polynomial trial space.
items.strategy: State the inner-product equations without assuming existence or uniqueness; prove both before using the projection operator.

items.title: Upwind SBP-SAT discretization of constant transport
items.statement: Define the strong-form diagonal-norm SBP transport operator with an upwind SAT at every face and inflow boundary data.
items.strategy: State the exact SAT sign and use the same oriented upwind flux as the DG definition.

items.title: Upwind DG transport satisfies the semidiscrete L2 energy identity
items.statement: Prove the exact cell-summed L2 balance, including upwind jump dissipation, outflow energy and the inflow-data contribution, for the DG method.
items.strategy: Use the actual simplex Green identity and opposite interior normals, then calculate each signed upwind face contribution.

items.title: Conservative flux-differencing SBP method for nonlinear systems
items.statement: Define the affine-element flux-differencing volume residual from symmetric consistent directional entropy-conservative two-point fluxes, paired face quadrature and a conservative normal numerical flux satisfying Tadmor's interface inequality.
items.strategy: State the entropy-pair and flux assumptions direction by direction, the exact SBP/metric identities, paired nodes, face SAT and boundary entropy condition; exclude curved meshes.

items.title: The cellwise L2 projection exists uniquely and is best approximation
items.statement: Prove existence, uniqueness, orthogonality and the L2 best-approximation inequality for the cellwise projection.
items.strategy: Use positive definiteness of the finite-dimensional Gram matrix and the Pythagorean identity.

items.title: The degree-zero upwind forward-Euler step preserves mass and convex entropy
items.statement: Under the stated face CFL, prove conservation of the cell-volume-weighted mean and nonincrease of the weighted sum of every convex scalar entropy.
items.strategy: Rewrite each cell update as a convex combination using the zero total normal flux identity, apply Jensen, and reindex paired face contributions.

items.title: Upwind SBP-SAT transport satisfies the semidiscrete L2 energy identity
items.statement: Prove the discrete-norm energy balance for the upwind SBP-SAT transport operator, including interelement jump dissipation and the exact inflow/outflow terms.
items.strategy: Contract the matrix ODE with the state, apply the stated SBP identity, and pair the two traces at each interface.

items.title: Smooth-solution L2 error bound for upwind DG transport
items.statement: Prove a projection-residual L2 error bound with the exact upwind-trace consistency term for a smooth solution on a fixed affine mesh.
items.strategy: Subtract the exact weak equation, use cellwise projection orthogonality to cancel volume residuals, and absorb face residuals with upwind dissipation.

items.title: Flux-differencing SBP is conservative and semidiscretely entropy stable
items.statement: Prove conservation of the nodal weighted mean and the global semidiscrete entropy inequality under the exact paired-node SBP identities, entropy-stable interface flux condition and stated boundary entropy condition.
items.strategy: Use symmetry and the Tadmor jump identity in the volume pair sum, convert it to face terms with SBP, then cancel conservative fluxes and apply the interface and boundary inequalities.

items.title: SSPRK(3,3) preserves the degree-zero upwind entropy bound
items.statement: For the exact SSPRK(3,3) three-stage recurrence and the same step bound, prove preservation of the degree-zero periodic upwind method's convex entropy bound by the proved forward-Euler transfer result.
items.strategy: Instantiate NA15's coefficient-one convex transfer with the weighted scalar entropy; assert no transfer to the high-order nonlinear DG/SBP semidiscretization.

title: Hyperbolic DG and summation-by-parts methods — Examples

items.title: Underintegrated Burgers collocation can increase quadratic entropy
items.statement: Give exact three-node Gauss-Lobatto SBP data and a periodic Burgers state for which the naively collocated strong form has positive quadratic-entropy production.
items.strategy: Verify the SBP matrix identity and compute the exact nodal residual and weighted entropy derivative.

items.title: Central and upwind fluxes have different periodic dissipation
items.statement: Compare the degree-zero central and upwind two-cell periodic scalar transport schemes and calculate their discrete L2 energy rates.
items.strategy: Substitute the fixed cell values into both shared face-flux updates and sum the weighted energy derivative.

items.title: A constant upwind DG state with inflow data on one interval
items.statement: Compute the exact degree-zero DG ODE and its energy balance on one right triangle for constant horizontal transport with prescribed inflow.
items.strategy: Evaluate the three oriented face fluxes and simplify the scalar energy identity.

items.title: The SBP inflow SAT produces the boundary energy term
items.statement: Verify the inflow SAT energy identity for the two-node diagonal-norm SBP derivative on one interval.
items.strategy: Insert the explicit H, D and boundary vectors, then contract the exact SAT equation with the nodal state.
